title: Pressure Washing in Micanopy, FL | Gentle Soft Washing
description: Pressure washing in Micanopy, FL done gently: low-pressure soft washing for old wood siding, roofs, and porches, plus pressure cleaning for walks and drives.
h1: Pressure Washing and Soft Washing in Micanopy, FL
heroIntro: Old wood siding and porch trim do not survive a heavy-handed pressure washer. In Micanopy, most of our cleaning is low-pressure soft washing that kills mildew without damaging the house.

sections.h2: Why high pressure and old houses do not mix
body: A pressure washer strong enough to clean concrete can gouge soft, aged wood, strip paint that is still well bonded, and force water up behind lap siding and into wall cavities. On a pre-war Micanopy home, that can do more damage in an afternoon than a year of mildew. It can also shatter old window glazing and blow apart brittle caulk.
That is why pressure washing in Micanopy, FL is mostly soft washing for us: low pressure and a cleaning solution that kills mildew and algae at the root, followed by a thorough rinse.

Shade and humidity make Micanopy a friendly place for green algae, black mildew, and lichen. They show up on north and east walls, porch ceilings, eaves, and roofs under overhanging limbs. Oak pollen in spring and leaf drop through the year add yellow and brown staining on porches, railings, and screens. Left alone, that growth holds moisture against the surface and shortens the life of paint and wood.
Our guide to mold and mildew on siding explains what each type is, and our article on pollen stains covers the seasonal yellow film.

sections.h2: Matching the method to the surface
bullets: Painted wood siding, trim, and porch ceilings: soft wash only
Roofs with algae streaks: soft wash, never high pressure
Screens and railings: low pressure and hand detail
Concrete walks, drives, and patios: pressure washing where the surface can take it
Brick and older masonry: tested low-pressure cleaning, adjusted to the material's condition
body: Plants are wet down and covered, windows are closed, and runoff is directed away from beds before we start.

Porches deserve a careful hand. Painted porch floors, beadboard ceilings, and turned spindles on older homes are cleaned at low pressure and rinsed thoroughly, so the wash does not lift paint that is still holding or push water into joints that will be slow to dry in the shade.

Every exterior repaint includes a wash and mildew treatment, because paint applied over growth fails from underneath. If you are planning exterior painting in Micanopy, washing is already in that estimate. If the paint is still sound and simply dirty, a stand-alone wash can buy time before a repaint, and the crew lead will tell you which you need.

Shops downtown can be washed early or after hours so storefronts are clean before customers arrive. See our Micanopy commercial painting page for scheduling details, or our main pressure washing service page.

faqs.q: Will soft washing hurt the old wood siding on my house?
faqs.a: No. Soft washing uses low pressure and a cleaning solution, so it removes mildew without gouging wood or stripping sound paint.

faqs.q: Can you clean algae streaks off my roof?
faqs.a: Yes, using a soft wash method. Roofs should never be cleaned with high pressure.

faqs.q: How often should a shaded Micanopy house be washed?
faqs.a: It depends on shade, moisture, and how fast growth returns. The crew lead can look at your home and suggest a sensible interval.
